Oscillating plates move each foot alternately, like a see-saw; lineal plates move straight up and down. The plate should fit a squat stance and be rated above your weight. Claude's choice is the LifePro Waver line, GPT's the Power Plate my3. https://1billionmodels.com/sports-and-outdoors/sports-and-fitness/exercise-and-fitness-equipment/cardio-training/vibration-platform-machines?src=youtube&utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=answer
